clos.loDetails: Understand terms in American culture such as “salad bowl”, “equality”, “the American dream”, “individualism” and other important issues relating to different fields such as geography, history, politics, habits and customs, human, etc.
Comprehend the significance of course-related issues; make comparisons between Vietnamese and American cultures.
Describe appropriate communicative manners toward people from different cultural backgrounds; giving self-motivation in learning and researching cultures associated with target language.

Apply related knowledge to reinforcing intercultural communications between Vietnam-America .in order to avoid cultural conflicts while communicating and be able to mingle with people from different countries more easily.
